scope: Staging and production root, state, resource, binding, credential, identity, and zero-traffic fences

evidence: Separate Terraform roots and environment-named remote-state keys
Each root declares one distinct environment-named Neon project and supports a project/bootstrap-only phase before Cloudflare foundation materialization
Disjoint prefixes for Neon projects, endpoints/direct hosts, R2, Queues/DLQs, Hyperdrive, Workflows, Workers, Access, and secret ownership
Six SQL-created Worker logins use exact environment-and-role names; a same-environment, exact-project, exact-branch, exact-endpoint, exact-direct-host catalog attestation gates each Hyperdrive config
The attestation runner accepts only the environment and constructs the verify-full connection from that root's resolved Terraform outputs
The attestation is valid for at most 15 minutes and apply-time timestamp must be inside its verification/expiry interval
Terraform recomputes the SHA-256 of the full canonical envelope so a modified field cannot reuse the original digest
No public-to-mutation Hyperdrive config reuse is possible

Adversarial cross-environment, cross-project, cross-branch, cross-endpoint, wrong-host, stale saved-plan, future, same-digest mutation, cross-role, elevated-privilege, and API-created-role candidates are rejected
Both environments have workers_dev false and empty routes

required_evidence: Encrypted remote-state bucket and lock recovery evidence for each environment
Terraform state/resource diff with no shared IDs
Negative staging credentials and privilege-attestation receipts against production resources and inverse
Distinct SQL-created managed service identities and database credentials with zero neon_superuser membership

authorization_boundaries.AUTH-02: create isolated control-plane state, identities, IDs, secrets, and Access
authorization_boundaries.AUTH-11: separate zero-traffic production foundation apply after staging acceptance; does not authorize routes, DNS, or traffic

non_claims: No remote state exists from this work
